value.rationale: The three-corner face-avoidance hierarchy is the natural strengthened square constraint next to classical cubical theta complexes, and its first nontrivial examples show an unexpected mixed-dimensional n=4 to degree-seven 681-class n=5 transition. Determining complete integral groups with verified torsion absence across 3.3 million faces is a motivated finite structural cutoff; no unearned general-family theorem or homotopy classification is claimed.
